openHint: Open a module to edit its settings. Use the switch to turn it on or off.
betaLockedBody: This is in beta and open to Premium channels only for now. It unlocks for everyone when the beta ends; anything you set up during beta keeps working.
catChannelHint: Channel points, follow and sub alerts, and raid shoutouts.
catChatHint: Timers, trigger words, quotes, and what chat types.
catGearHint: Connect Spotify for song requests and Govee for your lights.
catModerationHint: Filters and AutoMod for keeping chat clean.
catPointsHint: Loyalty currency, counters, and the games that spend them.
catStatsHint: Stats commands for the game you are playing: Fortnite, Valorant, Minecraft, Call of Duty: Mobile, and more.
commandsHint: Turn the module on to unlock these chat commands.
degraded: Module settings are temporarily unavailable. Showing defaults.
description: Find a feature by name, by what it does, or by a chat command. {active} of {total} on.
disabledNote: This module is off. The settings and replies below stay editable and take effect as soon as you turn it on.
discardBody: You have unsaved changes here. Discard them?
errTriggerResponseRequired: Enter the response to send in chat.
enabledHelp: Turn this module on or off for your channel.
inspectorIdle: Select a module to configure it here.
nestedUnder: This game spends {parent}. Turn it on from there. It cannot run on its own.
noMatchBody: Try a command like !sr, a game name, or what you want the bot to do.
noTriggersBody: Add a rule to reply automatically when a word shows up in chat.
offConfigurable: This module is off. You can configure it now; changes take effect when you enable it.
patchConflict: Someone else changed this module. The latest version was reloaded, so redo your change.
replyBlankHint: Leave blank to use the default message.
replyIdle: Select a message to edit it here.
triggerReserved: That phrase uses reserved syntax (=>, a leading #, or a mode: prefix). Please rephrase it.
triggerRulesHint: Reply when a message matches a phrase, no "!" needed. First match wins.
tzNoMatch: No timezone matches. Try a city, like Toronto or Paris.
tzSuggested: Your browser reports {tz}. Detected on your device only; nothing is stored unless you apply it.
matchHintContains: Fires when the phrase appears anywhere, even inside another word.
matchHintExact: Fires only when the whole message equals the phrase.
matchHintPrefix: Fires when the message begins with the phrase.
matchHintWord: Fires when the phrase appears as its own word (so "hi" will not fire inside "this").
deleteRuleBody: The rule for "{phrase}" will be removed and stop replying in chat.
lockedHint: Premium only. Upgrade to change this.
